understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid, modify the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation as needed, and step onto every goal cell while all three attributes match its requirements. Complete all goals in each level to advance and ultimately win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina. Reaching zero stamina costs a life and restores stamina to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement, so the listed blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activates only when shape, color, and rotation all match, and stepping onto an activated goal completes it.
